- **19:30 Belcanto** – special dinner, two‑Michelin‑star tasting menu. High‑budget. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lisbon/Bairro_Alto)

### Day 5 – Fri 2027-05-14: Parque das Nações
*Weather*: overcast – 2.3 km walk
- **10:00 Calouste Gulbenkian Museum** – world‑class collection spanning antiquities to modern art. Open Su‑Mo, We‑Fr 10:00‑18:00; Sa 10:00‑21:00. ticket price: see the website. [source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Calouste_Gulbenkian_Museum)
